messages.subject: Project Mallory — conditions precedent checklist for signing on 27 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace, Naomi,

Attached is the CP checklist for signing on Friday 27 February. Outstanding items from your side: (1) the directors' certificate of solvency, dated the signing date; (2) evidence of receipt of the £2.0m equity; and (3) the board and shareholder resolutions in final form. We'll handle the MR01 filings after completion. Could you confirm the £2m timing?

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
